quests.title: The Adventurers' Guild's Affairs

dialogue.t: <color=#00E1FFFF>Ash</color>, huh... The description is detailed enough, sure, but it's not going to be easy finding a cat that's lost out in the wild.
Meow...
Huh? Why would there be a cat here?
Meow... Meeeow...
A gray cat, lost in the wild...
Ah, Lan mentioned a commission to look for a gray cat. Maybe this is the one! Paimon remembers that it was called Ash or something like that...
Who'd have thought that we'd find it here... Has it been hiding around here all this time?
Guess the Stonehide Lawachurl prevented anyone from searching for it here, and since it was too scared to leave, it just hid.
Sure is lucky that we came over, or it might've had to wait for a while longer, huh?
Meow... Meow, meow!

dialogue.sit: Let's take the cat back to Lan.

dialogue.t: Hey, what are you doing? Paimon doesn't think it understands what you're saying anyway...
Let's just bring it back to Lan, and let her return it to the person who put the commission up.
Meow... Meow! Meow!

dialogue.sit: It seems to agree with us.

dialogue.t: Oh, come on! It's not going to understand you no matter how hard you try to copy it. Let's just bring it with us already.
Have you defeated the Stonehide Lawachurl?

dialogue.sit: We defeated it, and we also found Ash...

dialogue.t: Thanks, you've done us a favor. With this commission under our belt, we'll have no problem proving the Guild's ability.
Meow, meow... Meow?
This cat is...
Give me a moment, let me check its features against the list of features written down in the commission.
Let's see...
It mostly checks out. This seems to be the cat we're looking for.
Hah. After all those twists and turns, we came right back to looking for lost cats.
I'm really not sure what to say...
I'll report these commissions to their commissioners. Thank you very much — please accept this as compensation for doing us this favor.
Hmm, it seems that the commissioner for the cat-related commission has since moved. It'll take some time to contact them.
Guess I'll just have to take care of this rascal in the meantime.
Meow-meow, meow!

quests.description: Lan seems to be fretting over some of the commissions that the Adventurers’ Guild has undertaken…
